== Notes ==
* This skill triggers when the target [[Fail#Skills that have an effect when an attack fails to hit|fails to hit]], for ''whatever'' reason. Hence, [[block]]ing with a skill, simply [[Line of sight|dodging a ranged attack, or even using the terrain to avoid being hit]] by a [[ranged attack]] will trigger the damage.
* Combine with skills that causes [[Blind]]ness to increase the miss chance and improve damage rate.
* This skill can be combined with [[Spirit of Failure]] as each will cause the foe to miss more often, thereby triggering both effects more frequently than either alone; however, hexes that make the target "miss" combine multiplicatively and not additively. Thus, a foe hexed with both [[Reckless Haste]] and Price of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks.
